_comment: Documentation Center config. Copy to docs.json and edit per server (docs.json is gitignored). Every value is OPTIONAL. See DOCS_DESIGN.md / GUIDE.md.
_base_dir_note: base_dir defaults to the portable 'document_repo' folder under backend/. A relative path is resolved against the backend dir (portable to every server — recommended); an absolute path (e.g. D:/ols/docs) is used as-is. Can also be set via the DOCS_BASE_DIR env var; the JSON value wins if both are set.
_formats_note: Discovery is automatic. Supported file types: .md/.markdown (rendered), .docx (Word → rendered), and text files shown verbatim in a notepad view: .txt .json .log .yml .yaml .xml .ini .conf .cfg .properties .csv .tsv .sql .sh .ps1 .bat .cmd .env
_audience_note: Audience is decided by the top-level SUBFOLDER under base_dir: files under user/ show in the User Guide, files under technical/ in the Technical Guide. Files elsewhere default to technical. An 'overrides' entry (keyed by the path relative to base_dir) always wins and can also set title/description/tags/order.
